title: Template facts (template-facts.json)
description: Real Word style facts extracted directly from a reference document's own word/styles.xml — font, size, bold/italic, alignment, per named style actually used. Deterministic extraction only, never invented (see extract-research-format SKILL.md's hard rules). tools/build-templates-from-facts.ts turns this into an actual template.dotx, so a human only has to review the rendered result instead of hand-authoring template-definitions.ts.

bodyFont.description: Default body font for the whole template, as found in the reference document's docDefaults/Normal style.

bodySizeHalfPoints.description: Default body size in half-points, i.e. 24 = 12pt.

styles.description: Every named style config.json's styleMap/headings actually reference — not every style the source document happens to define.

name.description: Word display name — what config.json's styleMap/headings reference by name.

color.description: Hex RGB without '#', e.g. "FF0000", as found in w:color.

outlineLevel.description: 0-based. Set on heading styles so Word's TOC/navigation work.
